name: com.vehiclephysics.pro-community
description:
Advanced vehicle simulation package providing fully realistic and accurate vehicle dynamics. Vehicle Physics Pro implements an industry-grade, AAA-class vehicle dynamics simulation model comparable with major vehicle simulation franchises.

 ▪ Physically accurate vehicle dynamics model.
 ▪ Modular drivetrain model: Engine, clutch/torque converter, gearbox, differential.
 ▪ Advanced tire friction model: static, adherent and sliding forces.
 ▪ Highly efficient design with minimal CPU impact.
 ▪ Consistent with Unity: components, gizmos, inspectors, menus...
 ▪ Simple integration into existing projects.

Community Edition:

 ▪ Vehicle Controller and essential add-on components
 ▪ 2 axles - 4 wheels per vehicle
 ▪ 1 vehicle per scene
 ▪ Single ground material
 ▪ Support desktop builds only

samples.description: Sample scenes and demo content, including preconfigured vehicle prefabs and scenery assets.
